A 6-year-old boy presents to the emergency department after falling from his scooter.
He fell sideways off the scooter as he rounded a curve in the road.
His mother notes that her brother has had similar problems.
On physical exam, the patient has extensive bruising of the lateral left thigh and tenderness to palpation.
His parents deny that he has an abnormal number of nosebleeds or bleeding from the gums.
His temperature is 98.6°F (37°C), blood pressure is 112/74 mmHg, pulse is 82/min, and respirations are 11/min.
They have never seen blood in his stool or urine.
